intro: A strong impact makes one or more clear comparisons that show why the argument matters beyond the debate — both on its own and against what the other side will say.

criteria.name: Magnitude
criteria.test: Names who is affected and how many — and weighs by vulnerability, not just headcount.
criteria.good: Millions of students spend hours every night on homework — that's time taken from every family.

criteria.name: Probability
criteria.test: Says how likely the consequence is, with a reason to believe it — not a vague 'might happen.'
criteria.good: Schools that cut homework already saw students sleeping more and reporting less stress.

criteria.name: Timeframe
criteria.test: Says when the consequence hits — immediately, over a semester, across a generation.
criteria.good: Students would get their evenings back starting the first week, and the mental health effects compound over a full school year.
